articles.summary: Third Quarter Net Revenue of $182.2 Million, Up 9.7% Sequentially from the Second Quarter Reaches Record Dollar and Volume Share of the Shell Egg Category Updates Fiscal Year 2026 Net Revenue Outlook to around $730 Million and Adjusted EBITDA Outlook to a Loss of around $(15) Million Withdraws Previously Issued Fiscal 2030 Financial Targets Vital Farms (Nasdaq: VITL), a Certified B Corporation that offers a range of ethically produced foods nationwide, today reported financial results for its third quarter ended September 27, 2026. Financial highlights for the third quarter ended September 27, 2026, compared to the third quarter ended September 28, 2025, where applicable, include: Net Revenue of $182.2 million, a decrease of 8.4% year over year and an increase of 9.7% sequentially from the second quarter of fiscal 2026 Gross Margin of 23.1%, compared to 37.7% Net Loss of $6.5 million, compared to Net Income of $16.4 million Net Loss per Diluted Share of $0.15, compared to Net Income
articles.title: Vital Farms Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
